optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Capacity Planning Analyst, Enterprise Knowledge Base
professionalSummary: Keeps a per-customer load model that predicts search queries and sync volume from user counts and document growth; recalibrated monthly against the platform metrics warehouse.
Turns quarterly forecasts into index‑shard and storage plans presented to the platform team.
Reduces capacity‑related incidents by applying shard rebalancing plans.
Facilitates capacity changes through quarterly planning meetings, recording approvals from platform leads and customer teams.
Maintains an assumptions note per cycle covering model inputs, limitations, and hand‑over items.
experienceHighlights: Per‑customer load model maintained and recalibrated monthly.
Forecasts translated into index‑shard and storage plans for quarterly planning meetings.
Capacity‑related incidents decreased from 7 to 2 in the second half of the year.
Capacity changes approved by platform lead and communicated to customer teams.
Assumptions notes kept for each planning cycle.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Year‑long incident register filtered to capacity‑related incidents with baseline and rebalancing plan marked; includes export identifiers for tracing.

role.roleTitle: Capacity Planning Analyst, Enterprise Knowledge Base

evidence.text: Kept the per-customer load model that predicts search queries and sync volume from user counts and document growth; every month I recalibrated it against the platform metrics warehouse.
Turned each quarter's forecast into an index-shard and storage plan that the platform team and I took to the quarterly planning meeting.

Capacity-related incidents fell from 7 in the first half of the year to 2 in the second half after the shard rebalancing plan was applied, as counted in the platform incident register against its published baseline of 7 incidents per half-year.

Took capacity changes through the quarterly planning meeting with the platform and customer teams; the platform lead approved shard changes and the customer teams handled communication with their accounts.
Kept an assumptions note per cycle covering the model inputs, the fact that bulk document imports sat outside the forecast, and what the next cycle inherited.
